# Invented Quiver-shaped fixtures

All four JSON files contain **invented values**, locally authored for offline engineering tests.
They are not recorded API responses, licensed vendor records, actual disclosures, real people,
real transactions or research results. Repeated equal-valued transactions are intentional.

The public official schema reviewed2026-10-22 defines the response shapes:
https://api.quiverquant.com/docs/schema.json
SHA-256 `72b5c480c44494371c318c88072319795bf8440600998d81d297b5cd3de17af2`.
Field names/structure follow CongressionalTrade, CongressionalTradeV2, GovContractAll and
LobbyingRecord. Labels, BioGuide identifiers, symbols, classifications, dates and amounts here
were invented. Future-metric fields illustrate prohibited inputs; tests add further invented
unknown fields in memory. No Quiver data redistribution permission is asserted or needed for
this invented subset; no real raw vendor payload is committed.

The supporting primary-government disclosure and reviewed mappings in tests are also explicitly
invented. They simulate canonical inputs for reconciliation and evidence tests; no live primary
government adapter or real match validation is implied.

See [adapter contract and limits](../../../docs/17-quiver-context.md). Applicable actual API
agreement, account entitlement and any real raw/derived retention remain pending. Do not replace
these files with licensed records. Keep real raw/staged/curated vendor state private, outside
Git and cloud sync, under reviewed retention rights.
